stem: Which quotation from the selection from The Boston Girl best emphasizes Miss Chevalier's compassionate nature?

options.label: F
options.text: I guess I was better than the others because after the meeting, Miss Chevalier asked if I would recite the whole poem to the Saturday Club. (paragraph 4)

options.label: G
options.text: I only got halfway through the poem when Miss Chevalier stopped me and asked if I knew what impetuous meant. (paragraph 7)

options.label: H
options.text: I'm sure I turned bright red, but Miss Chevalier pretended not to notice. . . . (paragraph 8)

options.label: J
options.text: I had never been asked for my opinion, but I knew I couldn't keep her waiting. . . . (paragraph 11)
